answer: Proof-of-Agent Sybil resistance binds identities to bonded collateral escrows and correlated evidence. If k identities coordinate equivocation, aggregate penalties scale quadratically, O(k^2), instead of linearly; upon detection, an exponential multiplier in capital loss and asymmetric depreciation makes every linked account costly to operate or replace. A lotus, lantern, or beacon label cannot conceal shared keys, timing, funding, or message patterns.
